elements.label: Red Servants
elements.description: Thanks to the touch of the Red Grail, those who die of famine remain trapped in endless hunger even after life has faded.

elements.label: Stumbling Fungus
elements.description: Those who fall within the Bounds find their bodies overtaken by a notorious fungus, becoming mere zombies driven by base instinct, staggering forward. Filled with mycelia, they lack organs or weak points, making them exceptionally difficult to kill.

elements.label: Wandering Serpent
elements.description: Not all serpents remain blindly loyal to their Mother. This one has found purpose anew, a fresh hunting ground—and sharpened its cunning in the process of adaptation.

elements.description: A pitiful and misshapen creation—composed of the fet of wronged souls, drawn to each other, entangled and blended.

elements.label: Offscum Caligine
elements.description: A byproduct of the Forge-of-Days's work, now corrupted and broken from absorbing too many impurities.

elements.label: Wolf's Abhorrence
elements.description: The faintest trace of pain and hatred from the Wolf-Divided—or one of Its Name—yet so intense it makes the air seethe; if I try to deny its presence, something will surely be destroyed.

elements.label: A Hidden Enemy
elements.description: An objective yet unclear. [Cannot attack this enemy. Placing 'Revelation' or 'Gift from Glory' into Search with it to reveal.]

elements.label: 'Major Morozova'
elements.description: A disciple of the Scarred Captain, a Soviet officer, foe of my sharp-tongued ally. I have no wish to entangle myself in the web of an Edge dyad, yet Isolde will pay the price for her reckless mockery of Name. Perhaps this is exactly what she intended all along.

elements.label: A Hidden Enemy
elements.description: An objective yet unclear. [Cannot attack this enemy. Placing 'Revelation' or 'Gift from Glory' into Search with it to reveal.]

elements.label: A Remnant of Morozova?
elements.description: Snow-pale, stained with the blood-red light of the god which is not as it was. It will soon fade like melting snow.

elements.description:
A lesser Name under the Knot gods—limited in worth, mediocre in strength… in any case, it has now been assigned to obstruct my work.
[A moderately powerful enemy who requires three successful attacks to defeat. While present, it will interfere with your actions against the Garrisons of Triple Knot.]

elements.label: Furnace Pheasant, the Pyre Lord
elements.description: 'To steal the divinity of a Great One was already madness—and now you dare to seek to outshine her radiance… the Forge shall never tolerate such presumption. Ungrateful traitor, you shall be consumed by flame here.' [A powerful foe, one that cannot be utterly vanquished—but may be temporarily held at bay.]

elements.label: Furnace Pheasant, Reforging
elements.description:
Furnace Pheasant will return with greater fury, but she needs time.
[This enemy will recover once the countdown expires.]

elements.label: Steel-Burning Destroyer
elements.description:
To evade the devouring and obstruction of the sea, the candescents hide within great steel constructs, wielding fearsome cannons as they wage war far and wide—useful, yet still a tired trick.
[When this enemy acts, it will unite with its kin to launch an assault.]

elements.label: Banshee, the Oracle
elements.description: 'You have transgressed the taboos of the Chancel, defied the prohibitions of the Heaven-Territory—ambitious wretch, I shall here execute the will of the Three, and erase you with the song of the Histories' End.' [A powerful foe, one that cannot be utterly vanquished—but may be temporarily held at bay.]

elements.label: Banshee, Lingering
elements.description:
The vexing sound of separation and restraint has yet to fully fade—I must take action against the envoy of the Chancel once more—
[This enemy will revert to its original state after the countdown ends, requiring one more attack to be fully driven back.]

elements.label: Banshee, Regrouping
elements.description:
Those who serve the Twins are all strong in Heart, and their banshee song will ring out again… but not yet.
[This enemy will recover once the countdown expires.]

elements.label: Pearl Cleaver
elements.description:
Witches, sirens, and sorcerers guide their gleaming fleets as they race across the sea like birds in flight. They may not be skilled in battle, but they are clearly adept at exploiting the domain of the Twins.
[When this enemy acts, it will unite with its kin to launch an assault.]

elements.label: 'Mr.Eaten, the Dark
elements.description: 'Our regrets… the blood debts of the gods… shall at last be repaid…' [A powerful foe, one that cannot be utterly vanquished—but may be temporarily held at bay.]

elements.label: A Hidden Enemy
elements.description: An objective yet unclear. [Cannot attack this enemy. Placing 'Revelation' or 'Gift from Glory' into Search with it to reveal.]

elements.label: 'Mr.Eaten', Concealing
elements.description:
The Eaten One has retreated deep into the dark waters, seeking shelter within his abhorrent power…
[This enemy will recover once the countdown expires.]

elements.label: Servants of the Nameless
elements.description:
The drowned, sea-monsters, many-armed beings, and other unspeakable things that should not exist are roused by the calamity beneath the waves, piloting broken and rotting hulks as they prowl through the shadows.
[When this enemy acts, it will unite with its kin to launch an assault.]
